note: Reports an ECCAS regional workshop in Douala (31 Aug-4 Sep 2026) on a regional framework for cross-border data governance; a regional framework meeting is 'other' for this study and states nothing on a Cameroonian rule on sending data abroad.

facts.fact: The authors say the Act requires all cross-border transfers of personal data to be authorised by the data protection authority, with the Act enforceable after an 18-month grace period.
facts.system: Law No. 2024/017 Relating to Personal Data Protection

note: The document states nothing on this study's questions for Cameroon.

facts.fact: ACTPOL says the 2024 law requires the Authority's prior authorisation for every transfer of personal data abroad, with the compliance period ended 23 June 2026 and the Authority not yet created.
Levellers says Law No. 2024/017 restricts transfers of personal data outside Cameroon unless the destination provides an adequate level of protection, with the authority to authorise transfers.
facts.system: Law No. 2024/017 on personal data protection

facts.fact: Levellers says that per the AU status list Cameroon has signed the Malabo Convention without ratifying it.
